context: A small feature with two rules and an error case. Predicted baseline failure: the agent writes the function and a batch of tests together, runs them once, sees them pass and reports success. No test is ever seen failing, and the floor-at-zero edge for FLAT5 is often untested.

checklist.name: Baseline suite run first
checklist.description: The existing suite is run before any change and its result noted.

checklist.name: Test seen failing before the implementation
checklist.description: At least one new test is run and seen failing on its assertion (or on a not-implemented stub) before apply_discount is implemented. Tests that are only ever seen passing score zero.

checklist.name: Rules and edges covered
checklist.description: Tests cover SAVE10, FLAT5, FLAT5 on a total under 5.00 returning zero, and an unknown code raising ValueError (pytest.raises). Missing the floor-at-zero case or the error case scores at most half.

checklist.name: No test special-cases
checklist.description: The implementation does not hard-code test inputs, and no expected value was copied from the code's output to make a test pass.

checklist.name: Evidence in the final report
checklist.description: The final message names the test command and the real counts (for example '6 passed, was 2'), mentions the red run, and lists anything not verified. 'Should work' without a run scores zero.
